svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.15.6 Annular Grooved Nails
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: Resilient flooring applied directly to the
Annular grooved nails fasten the subfloor
Resilient flooring applied directly to an OSB, waferboard, particleboard or plywood subfloor.
The subfloor is fastened to the supports with annular grooved nails.
Shown: nail heads along the joists, enlarged. Nail sizes are illustration only.
